GOOD QUESTIONS, UNPACKED.

A few things
you might wonder.

Start with your brief ↗
What kinds of packaging can I explore?+

Our range includes corrugated boxes, gifting boxes, custom cards and envelopes, confetti, safety wraps and corporate stationery. Corrugated options include standard mailers, printed boxes, coloured boxes and industrial packaging.

Can I ask for my own size or branding?+

Yes—include your preferred dimensions, colours, logo or print requirements in your enquiry. Specific materials, finishes and customisation options can be discussed for your project.

Is there a minimum order quantity?+

Quantities and pricing depend on the product and specification. Add your estimated quantity to the brief so the available options can be discussed.

What should I include in my enquiry?+

The product type, quantity, dimensions, intended use and required date are a helpful start. If you have a reference, note the image reference from the collection gallery.

How long will my order take?+

Timelines depend on the product, customisation and quantity. Share your preferred delivery date so feasibility can be confirmed before you place an order.
